blocks.zh: 本節學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives for This Section

blocks.zh: 理解全球上市後變更（PAC）流程為何耗時且複雜，並能以 CDMO 運營角色說明其商業影響。
blocks.en: Understand why the global post-approval change (PAC) process is so time-consuming and complex, and explain its commercial impact from a CDMO operations perspective.

blocks.zh: 掌握 TR91 的定位：它如何將 ICH Q12 的原則轉化為可操作的實務指引，填補「知道要做什麼」到「知道怎麼做」的落差。
blocks.en: Grasp where TR91 fits: how it turns the principles of ICH Q12 into practical, actionable guidance and closes the gap between "knowing what to do" and "knowing how to do it".

blocks.zh: 明確 TR91 的範疇：聚焦 CMC 變更，適用於小分子與大分子藥品，並延伸至非 ICH 地區。
blocks.en: Be clear on the scope of TR91: it focuses on CMC changes, applies to both small-molecule and large-molecule products, and extends to non-ICH regions.

blocks.zh: 熟悉核心術語：Established Conditions (ECs)、PACMP、Comparability Protocol，以及各縮寫的完整意涵。
blocks.en: Become familiar with the core terms: Established Conditions (ECs), PACMP and Comparability Protocol, together with the full meaning of each abbreviation.

blocks.zh: 從 CDMO 視角理解「法規彈性」與「提交負擔降低」如何成為競爭優勢，並思考 QTA 中責任歸屬的重要性。
blocks.en: Understand, from the CDMO perspective, how "regulatory flexibility" and "reduced submission burden" can become a competitive advantage, and consider why the allocation of responsibilities in the QTA matters.

blocks.zh: 1.0 Introduction 1.0 簡介
blocks.en: 1.0 Introduction

blocks.zh: 解說與思考 Commentary
blocks.en: Commentary and Reflection

blocks.zh: 核心概念：PAC 的全球困境
blocks.en: Core Concept: The Global PAC Dilemma

blocks.zh: PAC（Post-Approval Change，上市後變更）是任何已取得藥品許可的製造商都必須面對的課題。全球批准最長需 2–5 年，這意味著一個緊急的製程改善，可能在問題發生後好幾年才能在所有市場正式實施。
blocks.en: PAC (Post-Approval Change) is an issue every manufacturer holding a marketing authorization must deal with. Global approval can take 2–5 years, which means an urgent process improvement may not be formally implemented in all markets until several years after the problem arose.

blocks.zh: 對 CDMO 而言，這個時間差尤其關鍵：你必須在不同市場同時維持多個版本的製程，同步管理多套文件、驗證數據、以及不同批次的 QC 放行標準。
blocks.en: For a CDMO, this time gap is especially critical: you must maintain several versions of a process in different markets at the same time, while managing multiple sets of documents, validation data and QC release standards for different batches.

blocks.zh: 比喻：全球高速公路的紅綠燈
blocks.en: Analogy: Traffic Lights on a Global Highway

blocks.zh: 想像你要開車從台北到高雄，但每個城市的紅綠燈規則不一樣——有的地方綠燈 30 秒，有的地方需要先申請「變換車道許可」才能過彎。PAC 的全球申請就是這樣：同一個變更，美國 FDA 可能只需要 CBE-30（30天生效通知），但日本可能需要事前核准，而 WHO 又有另一套時程。結果是你在不同市場開著「不同版本的車」上路。
blocks.en: Imagine driving from Taipei to Kaohsiung, but every city has different traffic light rules: in some places the green light lasts 30 seconds, and in others you must first apply for a "lane change permit" before you can make a turn. A global PAC filing works the same way. For one and the same change, the US FDA may need only a CBE-30 (a notification that takes effect after 30 days), while Japan may require prior approval and WHO has yet another timeline. The result is that you are on the road in different markets driving "different versions of the car".

blocks.zh: 重點提示：COVID-19 的教訓
blocks.en: Key Point: Lessons from COVID-19

blocks.zh: 疫情是一個現實壓力測試。當原材料供應鏈斷裂、需要緊急替換供應商時，法規 PAC 流程的複雜性直接威脅藥品供應。這是 TR91 出版的直接背景之一——業界迫切需要一套更有彈性、更協調的工具。
blocks.en: The pandemic was a real-world stress test. When raw material supply chains broke down and suppliers had to be replaced urgently, the complexity of the regulatory PAC process directly threatened drug supply. This is one of the direct reasons TR91 was published: industry urgently needed a more flexible, better harmonized set of tools.

blocks.zh: 思考練習
blocks.en: Reflection Exercise

blocks.zh: 在你目前的 aseptic fill-finish 業務中，哪些類型的 CMC 變更（例如：更換初級包裝材料、調整滅菌參數、變更原料藥供應商）最常碰到跨地區申請的挑戰？這些變更的平均等待時間是多少？
blocks.en: In your current aseptic fill-finish business, which types of CMC changes (for example, changing the primary packaging material, adjusting sterilization parameters, or changing the drug substance supplier) most often run into multi-region filing challenges? What is the average waiting time for these changes?

blocks.zh: 1.1 Purpose 1.1 目的
blocks.en: 1.1 Purpose

blocks.zh: 核心概念：TR91 填補了什麼空缺？
blocks.en: Core Concept: What Gap Does TR91 Fill?

blocks.zh: ICH Q12 於 2019 年發布，建立了上市後變更管理的原則框架，引入了 ECs、PACMP 等概念。但 ICH Q12 是原則性文件，它告訴你「什麼是 Established Conditions」，卻不告訴你「如何在實際申請中設定 ECs」。
blocks.en: ICH Q12 was published in 2019 and established a principles-based framework for post-approval change management, introducing concepts such as ECs and PACMP. But ICH Q12 is a principles document: it tells you "what Established Conditions are", but not "how to set ECs in an actual submission".

blocks.zh: TR91 就是那本「操作手冊」——它把 ICH Q12 的概念翻譯成實務步驟，並附上假設性的 PACMP 案例，讓你看到真實的文件結構與科學論證邏輯。
blocks.en: TR91 is that "operating manual". It translates the ICH Q12 concepts into practical steps and adds hypothetical PACMP case studies, so you can see the real document structure and the logic of the scientific justification.

blocks.zh: 比喻：法律條文 vs 法庭實務手冊
blocks.en: Analogy: Statutes vs a Courtroom Practice Manual

blocks.zh: ICH Q12 好比法律條文——定義了規則與原則。TR91 好比法律從業者的實務手冊——告訴你在實際案例中怎麼寫狀紙、怎麼與法官（監管機構）談判、哪些證據最有說服力。兩者缺一不可。
blocks.en: ICH Q12 is like the statutes: it defines the rules and principles. TR91 is like a practitioner's manual for lawyers: it tells you how to draft the pleadings in an actual case, how to negotiate with the judge (the regulatory authority), and which evidence is most persuasive. You need both.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：CDMO 的特殊地位
blocks.en: Key Point: The Special Position of the CDMO

blocks.zh: TR91 的對象是「製藥業界」，但 CDMO 扮演的角色與 MAH（Marketing Authorization Holder，上市許可持有人）不同。CDMO 執行變更，MAH 擁有申請文件。因此，TR91 中所有「如何與監管機構談判」的指引，在 CDMO 情境下必須翻譯成：如何支援你的客戶（MAH）準備完整的 PAC 申請包裝，以及在 QTA 中清楚規範誰負責哪個環節。
blocks.en: TR91 is addressed to the "pharmaceutical industry", but the role of a CDMO differs from that of the MAH (Marketing Authorization Holder). The CDMO carries out the change, while the MAH owns the filing documents. Therefore, all the guidance in TR91 on "how to negotiate with regulators" must be translated, in a CDMO context, into: how to support your client (the MAH) in preparing a complete PAC submission package, and how to define clearly in the QTA who is responsible for which step.

blocks.zh: 你的公司目前是否已建立一套流程，協助客戶（MAH）準備 PACMP 或 Comparability Protocol？如果沒有，TR91 的附錄案例（Section 10 & 11）可以作為建立此類服務的起點。這是否可以成為 CDMO 的差異化服務項目？
blocks.en: Has your company established a process to help clients (MAHs) prepare a PACMP or Comparability Protocol? If not, the case studies in the TR91 appendices (Sections 10 & 11) can serve as a starting point for building such a service. Could this become a differentiating service offering for a CDMO?

blocks.zh: 1.2 Scope 1.2 範圍
blocks.en: 1.2 Scope

blocks.zh: 核心概念：TR91 的範疇邊界
blocks.en: Core Concept: The Boundaries of TR91

blocks.zh: TR91 的範疇非常明確——只涵蓋 CMC 變更（化學、製造與品管），適用於小分子藥品（化學藥）與大分子藥品（生物製劑，如 mAb、蛋白質藥物）。
blocks.en: The scope of TR91 is very clear: it covers only CMC changes (chemistry, manufacturing and controls). It applies to small-molecule drugs (chemical drugs) and large-molecule drugs (biologics, such as mAbs and protein drugs).

blocks.zh: 它不處理：
blocks.en: It does not address:

blocks.zh: 臨床安全性或有效性的重新評估
blocks.en: Re-evaluation of clinical safety or efficacy

blocks.zh: 適應症擴充或新劑型的初始申請
blocks.en: Initial applications for new indications or new dosage forms

blocks.zh: 非 CMC 的標籤變更
blocks.en: Non-CMC labeling changes

blocks.zh: 換言之，TR91 的核心問題是：「製造方式或品管方式改變了，我如何向監管機構證明產品品質沒有下降？」
blocks.en: In other words, the core question of TR91 is: "The way we manufacture or control the product has changed. How do I demonstrate to the regulator that product quality has not declined?"

blocks.zh: 比喻：裝修已有建築 vs 蓋新房子
blocks.en: Analogy: Renovating an Existing Building vs Building a New House

blocks.zh: TR91 談的是「已核准產品的裝修工程」——更換設備、改善製程、更換原料供應商。它不談「蓋新房子」（新產品開發），也不談「改變房子用途」（適應症變更）。這個邊界的釐清，讓你在閱讀每一個章節時，都能問自己：「這個變更是 CMC 性質的嗎？」
blocks.en: TR91 is about "renovating an approved product": replacing equipment, improving the process, changing the raw material supplier. It is not about "building a new house" (new product development), nor about "changing the use of the house" (a change of indication). Being clear about this boundary lets you ask yourself, as you read each section: "Is this change CMC in nature?"

blocks.zh: 重點提示：小分子與大分子的差異
blocks.en: Key Point: Differences Between Small and Large Molecules

blocks.zh: 雖然 TR91 同時適用於兩者，但大分子（biologics）的 PAC 通常更複雜：因為生物製劑的製程本身就定義了產品，任何製程變更都可能影響可比性（comparability）。這也是為什麼「Comparability Protocol」這個工具在生物製劑領域特別重要。
blocks.en: Although TR91 applies to both, PACs for large molecules (biologics) are usually more complex: because for a biologic the process itself defines the product, any process change may affect comparability. This is also why the "Comparability Protocol" is an especially important tool for biologics.

blocks.zh: TWi 目前的產品組合以哪類為主？如果未來承接生物製劑的 fill-finish 業務，你預期 PAC 管理流程會有哪些差異？TR91 的生物製劑相關指引對你的業務擴展有何參考價值？
blocks.en: Which category dominates the current TWi portfolio? If you take on fill-finish business for biologics in the future, what differences do you expect in PAC management processes? What reference value does the biologics-related guidance in TR91 have for your business expansion?

blocks.zh: 2.0 Glossary of Terms 2.0 術語詞彙表
blocks.en: 2.0 Glossary of Terms

blocks.zh: 2.1 Glossary 2.1 詞彙表
blocks.en: 2.1 Glossary

blocks.zh: 核心術語解析：三個最重要的概念
blocks.en: Core Terms Explained: The Three Most Important Concepts

blocks.zh:
1. Established Conditions (ECs) — 已建立條件
ECs 是核准文件中被認定為「確保產品品質的關鍵描述」。任何對 ECs 的更動都需要向監管機構申報。理解 ECs 的範疇是 PAC 管理的起點——你必須先知道「什麼被鎖定了」，才能判斷一個變更是否需要申報。
blocks.en:
1. Established Conditions (ECs)
ECs are the "critical descriptions that ensure product quality" in the approved dossier. Any change to an EC must be reported to the regulatory authority. Understanding the scope of ECs is the starting point of PAC management: you must first know "what is locked in" before you can decide whether a change needs to be filed.

blocks.zh:
2. PACMP（Post-Approval Change Management Protocol）— 上市後變更管理協定
PACMP 是一種「預先協議」機制：你在實際執行變更之前，先向監管機構提交一份計畫，說明你將如何評估這個變更。一旦協議被核准，後續執行時只需提交數據確認，大幅簡化流程。
blocks.en:
2. PACMP (Post-Approval Change Management Protocol)
A PACMP is a "pre-agreement" mechanism: before actually implementing a change, you submit to the regulatory authority a plan describing how you will assess that change. Once the protocol is approved, you only need to submit data confirming the outcome at implementation, which greatly simplifies the process.

blocks.zh:
3. Product Lifecycle Management (PLCM) — 產品生命週期管理文件
PLCM 文件是整個 PAC 管理架構的「地圖」，列出所有 ECs、變更的申報類別、以及已核准的 PACMP。對 MAH 來說，這是與監管機構溝通的主文件；對 CDMO 來說，這是確認你的職責範圍的重要依據。
blocks.en:
3. Product Lifecycle Management (PLCM) document
The PLCM document is the "map" of the entire PAC management framework, listing all ECs, the reporting category for changes, and the approved PACMPs. For the MAH, it is the master document for communicating with regulators; for the CDMO, it is an important basis for confirming the scope of your responsibilities.

blocks.zh: 比喻：ECs vs 非 ECs
blocks.en: Analogy: ECs vs Non-ECs

blocks.zh: 把核准文件想像成一棟建築的「建照」。ECs 就像建照中明確載明的結構規格（牆厚、承重柱位置）——任何更動都必須重新申請許可。非 ECs 的部分就像室內裝潢——可以在一定範圍內自行更改，只需通知或備查。
blocks.en: Think of the approved dossier as the "building permit" for a building. ECs are like the structural specifications explicitly stated in the permit (wall thickness, positions of load-bearing columns): any change requires a new permit application. The non-EC parts are like interior decoration: they can be changed on your own within certain limits, requiring only notification or recording.

blocks.zh: PACMP 的價值在於：你提前告訴主管機關「我打算怎麼改牆」，取得預先認可。等你真正動工時，只需提交施工記錄，不需重新跑一次完整審查流程。
blocks.en: The value of a PACMP is that you tell the authority in advance "how I plan to change the wall" and obtain prior agreement. When you actually start work, you only need to submit the construction records, without going through a full review process again.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：FDA vs ICH 對 ECs 的定義差異
blocks.en: Key Point: How FDA and ICH Differ in Defining ECs

blocks.zh: FDA 將 ECs 定義為「確保製程表現與產品品質的描述」，較著重功能性。ICH 則強調 ECs 是「具法律約束力的資訊」。實務上，這個差異意味著在不同市場，同一個製程描述可能被歸類為不同程度的 EC，因此需要分別評估申報類別。
blocks.en: FDA defines ECs as "descriptions that ensure process performance and product quality", which is more functional in emphasis. ICH, by contrast, stresses that ECs are "legally binding information". In practice, this difference means that in different markets the same process description may be classified as an EC to a different degree, so the reporting category must be assessed separately.

blocks.zh: 在你目前負責的某個產品中，你能否列出 3–5 項你認為屬於 ECs 的製程參數或設備描述？這些項目目前如何在你的變更控制系統中被管理？是否有專門標記？
blocks.en: For a product you are currently responsible for, can you list 3–5 process parameters or equipment descriptions that you consider to be ECs? How are these items currently managed in your change control system? Are they specifically flagged?

blocks.zh: 2.2 Abbreviations 2.2 縮寫對照
blocks.en: 2.2 Abbreviations

blocks.zh: 縮寫速記：TR91 的核心語言
blocks.en: Abbreviations at a Glance: The Core Language of TR91

blocks.zh: 這份縮寫表是閱讀 TR91 全文的「解碼鑰匙」。以下幾組縮寫特別值得記憶：
blocks.en: This abbreviation list is the "decoder key" for reading the whole of TR91. The following groups of abbreviations are especially worth memorizing:

blocks.zh: PAC / PACMP / PAS：三個 P 開頭的縮寫，層層遞進——PAC 是概念，PACMP 是工具，PAS 是最高風險類別的申報形式（Prior Approval Supplement）。
blocks.en: PAC / PACMP / PAS: three abbreviations starting with P, building on one another. PAC is the concept, PACMP is the tool, and PAS is the filing form for the highest-risk category (Prior Approval Supplement).

blocks.zh: EC / CPP / CQA：品質管理的三角關係——CQA 定義產品品質目標，CPP 是影響 CQA 的製程參數，EC 是需要在核准文件中申報的關鍵描述（可能包含也可能不包含 CPP）。
blocks.en: EC / CPP / CQA: the triangle of quality management. CQAs define the product quality targets, CPPs are the process parameters that affect CQAs, and an EC is a critical description that must be reported in the approved dossier (it may or may not include a CPP).

blocks.zh: CBE（Changes Being Effected）：一種中等風險的申報途徑，先執行再申報（或申報同時執行），有 CBE-0 和 CBE-30 兩種。
blocks.en: CBE (Changes Being Effected): a moderate-risk reporting pathway in which the change is implemented first and reported afterwards (or implemented at the time of reporting). There are two types, CBE-0 and CBE-30.

blocks.zh: 比喻：PAC 申報的「速限分級」
blocks.en: Analogy: "Speed Limit Grades" for PAC Filings

blocks.zh: 把不同申報途徑想像成道路速限：
blocks.en: Think of the different reporting pathways as road speed limits:

blocks.zh: Prior Approval (PAS) = 高速公路施工 → 需要事前完整審查核准才能動工
blocks.en: Prior Approval (PAS) = highway construction: full prior review and approval is required before work can begin

blocks.zh: CBE-30 = 省道改道 → 先通知主管機關，30 天後若無異議才能實施
blocks.en: CBE-30 = a detour on a provincial road: notify the authority first, and you may proceed after 30 days if there is no objection

blocks.zh: CBE-0 / Notification = 巷道標線調整 → 通知即可，無需等待核准
blocks.en: CBE-0 / Notification = adjusting the lane markings on a side street: notification is enough, with no need to wait for approval

blocks.zh: Annual Report = 定期道路狀況回報 → 低風險變更，年底彙整申報即可
blocks.en: Annual Report = periodic road condition reporting: for low-risk changes, simply compile and report at year end

blocks.zh: PACMP 的價值在於：事先與監管機構協商好「哪些變更走哪條道路」，避免每次變更都要重新判斷。
blocks.en: The value of a PACMP is that you agree with the regulator in advance "which changes take which road", so you avoid having to decide this afresh for every change.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：ICH 的角色
blocks.en: Key Point: The Role of ICH

blocks.zh: ICH（人用藥品技術要求國際協調理事會）是 TR91 引用最多的標準制定機構。ICH Q12 是 PAC 管理的主要框架；ICH Q8/Q9/Q10 則提供了品質設計（QbD）、風險管理、與品質系統的基礎。TR91 大量引用這些 ICH 指引，因此對這些文件有基本認識是閱讀 TR91 的前提。
blocks.en: ICH (the International Council for Harmonisation of Technical Requirements for Pharmaceuticals for Human Use) is the standard-setting body most cited in TR91. ICH Q12 is the main framework for PAC management; ICH Q8/Q9/Q10 provide the foundation for quality by design (QbD), risk management and quality systems. TR91 cites these ICH guidelines extensively, so a basic understanding of them is a prerequisite for reading TR91.

blocks.zh: 在你的 CDMO 日常工作中，哪些縮寫最常出現在客戶溝通或 QTA 談判中？你是否遇過因為雙方對某個縮寫（例如 EC 的定義或 CBE vs PAS 的分類）理解不同而產生的溝通落差？TR91 的術語表能如何幫助建立共同語言？
blocks.en: In your day-to-day CDMO work, which abbreviations come up most often in client communications or QTA negotiations? Have you encountered communication gaps because the two sides understood an abbreviation differently (for example, the definition of an EC, or the classification of CBE vs PAS)? How can the TR91 glossary help build a common language?

blocks.zh: 本節摘要 — Section 1 & 2 Key Takeaways
blocks.en: Section Summary: Sections 1 & 2 Key Takeaways

blocks.zh: PAC 的全球挑戰是真實且代價高昂的：全球核准等待時間 2–5 年，直接影響製程改善速度、藥品供應穩定性，以及 CDMO 客戶關係的複雜度。
blocks.en: The global PAC challenge is real and costly: a global approval wait of 2–5 years directly affects the speed of process improvement, the stability of drug supply, and the complexity of CDMO client relationships.

blocks.zh: TR91 是 ICH Q12 的「實踐版」：它填補「知道什麼」到「知道怎麼做」的落差，並提供跨越 ICH 與非 ICH 地區的實務指引。
blocks.en: TR91 is the "practical edition" of ICH Q12: it closes the gap between "knowing what" and "knowing how", and provides practical guidance spanning ICH and non-ICH regions.

blocks.zh: 範疇清晰是閱讀 TR91 的基礎：本報告聚焦 CMC 變更，適用於小分子與大分子藥品，不涉及安全性/有效性的重新評估。
blocks.en: A clear scope is the foundation for reading TR91: this report focuses on CMC changes, applies to small-molecule and large-molecule drugs, and does not involve re-evaluation of safety/efficacy.

blocks.zh: 三個核心工具：ECs、PACMP、PLCM——理解這三者的定義與相互關係，是掌握整份報告的鑰匙。ECs 定義「什麼必須申報」，PACMP 提供「如何預先協商申報途徑」，PLCM 是整合所有資訊的主文件。
blocks.en: Three core tools: ECs, PACMP, PLCM. Understanding the definitions of these three and how they relate is the key to the whole report. ECs define "what must be reported", PACMP provides "how to agree the reporting pathway in advance", and PLCM is the master document that integrates all the information.

blocks.zh: CDMO 視角：CDMO 執行變更但 MAH 持有文件——QTA 中責任歸屬的清晰度，決定了 PAC 管理的效率與合規風險。TR91 的工具與案例，可直接轉化為 CDMO 支援客戶的服務能力，形成差異化競爭優勢。
blocks.en: The CDMO perspective: the CDMO executes the change but the MAH holds the documents, so the clarity of responsibility allocation in the QTA determines the efficiency of PAC management and the compliance risk. The tools and case studies in TR91 can be turned directly into service capabilities with which a CDMO supports its clients, creating a differentiated competitive advantage.
